literal: Among wealth, wealth is ear-wealth; that wealth among wealth all is head.
translation: The finest wealth among all wealth is the wealth of hearing. That wealth is the chief of all riches.
modern: செல்வங்களில் சிறந்த செல்வம் செவியால் கேட்டுப் பெறும் செல்வமே ஆகும். அந்தச் செல்வம் மற்ற எல்லாச் செல்வங்களிலும் முதன்மையானதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the supreme value of listening and learning. It calls the knowledge gained through the ear the greatest of all riches. While material wealth can be lost or stolen, the wealth of hearing remains secure and enriches the mind. Therefore, it stands as the head or chief among all types of wealth a person can possess.
